authority: RESEARCH_ONLY: no probability, bet, stake, approval or order is produced here

policy.applies_to: each team's projected points, in both directions; the range is the union over the four corners
policy.note: widening only: a larger multiplier can lower a lower bound and never raises one. No source measures how much a QB change or an absence moves a game, so these are stated assumptions, not estimates.

skill.method: Walk-forward test of the reference-class estimator against league frequency, per (quantity, period).
skill.not_an_edge_claim: no market lines exist in the repository; this measures distribution quality only
skill.rule: SUPPORTED iff the game-clustered 95% interval of the Brier gain over league frequency is above 0

direction_group_comparison.note: Same-direction comparison across families and periods (moneyline, spread, totals, team totals, halves, quarters). It shows headroom arithmetic and picks nothing; no family is favoured or forced.

caveats: ROI is realised after-fee P&L on settled accounted wagers; cells are small and were examined after the fact.
No model probability was recorded with these wagers, so handicapping error cannot be separated from pricing.
CLV below is vs the closing MID proxy from the evidence join. Executable (ask-side) CLV is NOT available in the repository's evidence join; it is reported as unavailable rather than approximated.
Nothing here excludes, favours or forces any family.

notes: NOT_EVALUATED means no analyst evaluation is on record; it is not a pass.
reference_class numbers are descriptive historical frequencies, never a probability or a status.
Nothing is ranked by attractiveness; candidates are listed by kickoff then ticker. No family is favoured or excluded and no diversification is forced.
